node.title: Why does eof have a prototype?
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
Hi

I'm trying to parse the usage infos in the pod of [DOC://perlfunc|perlfunc] to create code snippets, and am getting surprised by idiosyncrasies.

For instance is [DOC://eof|eof] magic when called with empty brackets eof()

but has a [DOC://prototype|prototype]

$ perl print prototype 'CORE::eof',"\n" __END__ ;* $

See also [DOC://perlsub|perlsub]

> Note however that some built-ins can't have their syntax expressed by a prototype (such as system or chomp). If you override them you won't be able to fully mimic their original syntax.

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
[id://1153804|Wikisyntax for the Monastery]
